# Summary and Questions


# Adiabatic simulation of CZ gate

We consider the adiabatic evolution of certain CZ gate protocol, such that only the geometric phase is kept.

Since the geometric phase is only related to the adabatic state path on the Bloch sphere,
we can use the adiabatic theorem to approximate the evolution of the system.
